notes.title: Neon Moon Dev Update!
notes.content:
🌙 Neon Moon Dev Update! 🌙

Hi everyone,

We at AHAKuo Creations want to thank you for your continued support and excitement for Neon Moon! Development has been moving steadily, and while we’ve been keeping quiet, rest assured the game is coming along with plenty of surprises in store.

🛠️ What’s Happening Behind the Scenes?
As a small and passionate team, we’re working hard to bring our vision to life. Our roadmap is a little rough, but every step gets us closer to something we’re proud to share with you.

🎮 Big News – Demo Coming in 2025!
We’re thrilled to announce that a demo is in the works and planned for release sometime in 2025. This will give you the chance to dive into the world of Neon Moon and experience the gameplay firsthand. Your feedback will be a key part of shaping the final game.

Thank you for sticking with us! We’ll keep you updated as we move forward, so stay tuned for more announcements. Your excitement and patience mean everything to us, and we can’t wait to share more of Neon Moon with you soon.

Cheers,
The AHAKuo Creations Team
